question: What should Resilience mean on a PR?

options.label: Recovers from failure (Recommended)
options.consequence: when something fails mid-way, the change retries within a budget, resumes, or degrades and names the cause, rather than leaving partial state

options.label: Withstands failure
options.consequence: fewer things can fail at all; close to the old Stability

options.label: Both
options.consequence: prevention and recovery; overlaps Stability and Security more
